How to donate to Flash Forward.

To donate, use the form on this page. Flash Forward Foundation is a student-led 501(c)(3), and a gift supports solar study lights so students can study after dark.

There is more than one way to help.

Support the Whole Journey

From components to a local handoff, every stage takes people and resources.

SUPPORT THE LIGHT

Affordable components help make the design possible. The current estimate is about $5.17 in parts per light, excluding delivery and other costs.

SUPPORT A BUILD

Hands-on teamwork brings schools, clubs, and makerspaces together to assemble and check lights.

SUPPORT A DELIVERY

Local partnerships connect finished lights with students. Quantities, timing, and destinations are coordinated with each partner.

Ways to Get Involved

  • The form on this page is the quickest way to give. Choose one-time or monthly on the form.

    Flash Forward Foundation is a US 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN 39-3605570. Many employers match gifts, so ask yours.

  • Study Circle is our monthly giving community. A regular gift helps us plan the next build and delivery.

    Explore Study Circle.

  • A school, club, business, or individual can support a defined build or delivery. We agree the scope with you first.

    Explore project sponsorship.

  • Businesses can fund the work, run an employee fundraiser, or offer useful materials and services.

    Explore corporate sponsorship.

  • Schools, robotics clubs, and makerspaces can become Builders and assemble study lights with us.

    Become a Builder.

  • Schools and nonprofits that serve students without reliable light can become distribution partners.

    Partner with us.

  • Students can intern with us in one of four tracks, or share our story as an ambassador.

    Explore internships or become an ambassador.
